engineered_bubr1.limitation: No experiment/cell nesting identifiers supplied for these columns. Selected timing and recruitment summaries are recomputed from published observations, not independently replicated experiments or evidence about N1002K/drug response. Nocodazole-arrest duration does not directly measure SAC-silencing kinetics; cellular PLK1 dependence does not establish direct phosphorylation of BubR1 T600/T608.
